candidates.name: Cable Overhead Press
candidates.cardText:
Cable Overhead Press
Novice
1
Use a handle attachment with the cable set to the bottom of the machine. Stand upright making sure to maintain a flat back. Your starting position will have your palms facing forward.
2
Use both your elbows and shoulders to press the weight directly overhead.

candidates.name: Cable Chest Press
candidates.cardText:
Cable Chest Press
Novice
1
Use a handle attachment. The cables should be set to shoulder height.
2
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
3
Walk a few steps forward. Then press the weight forward.
4
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.

candidates.name: Cable Low Single Arm Lateral Raise
candidates.cardText:
Cable Low Single Arm Lateral Raise
Novice
1
Use a handle attachment with the cable set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
2
You should vertically abduct at the shoulder raising your arm straight out to the side.
3
Raise until your arm is parallel with the ground and then back to the starting position.

candidates.name: Cable Upright Row
candidates.cardText:
Cable Upright Row
Advanced
1
Use a handle attachment with the cable set to the bottom of the machine.
2
Pull your elbows straight up toward the ceiling until the attachment is just below your chin then extend until your elbows are fully extended.

candidates.name: Cable Y Raise
candidates.cardText:
Cable Y Raise
Beginner
1
Stand over crossed low cables, holding the opposite handle in each hand.
2
Raise your arms upward and outward, forming a Y shape.
3
Pause near overhead, then slowly lower the handles.

candidates.name: Cable Bilateral Cross Upright Row
candidates.cardText:
Cable Bilateral Cross Upright Row
Beginner
1
Stand between crossed low cables, holding the opposite handle in each hand.
2
Pull both handles upward, leading with your elbows.
3
Stop near chest height, then lower the handles slowly.

candidates.name: Cable Thruster
candidates.cardText:
Cable Thruster
Beginner
1
Hold low cable handles at shoulder height with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2
Squat down while keeping your chest raised and knees tracking outward.
3
Stand powerfully and press both handles overhead until your arms are extended.

candidates.name: Cable Behind The Back Lateral Raise
candidates.cardText:
Cable Behind The Back Lateral Raise
Beginner
1
Place the cable all the way at the bottom and stand with the cable crossing behind your body.
2
While keeping your elbow mostly extended, lift your arm until it's parallel with the floor.

candidates.name: Cable Standing Single Arm Chest Press
candidates.cardText:
Cable Standing Single Arm Chest Press
Novice
1
Stand sideways to cable and hold handle at chest height with elbow bent.
2
Brace core and press handle straight forward without rotating torso.
3
Squeeze chest at extension, then return handle slowly to starting position.

candidates.name: Cable Standing Single Arm Incline Chest Press
candidates.cardText:
Cable Standing Single Arm Incline Chest Press
Intermediate
1
Stand sideways to cable with handle set low, holding it at chest height.
2
Press handle upward and forward at a slight diagonal, keeping torso stable.
3
Squeeze chest at the top, then return slowly to starting position.

candidates.name: Cable Internal Rotation
candidates.cardText:
Cable Internal Rotation
Beginner
1
Stand tall, hold the cable handle with a neutral grip, your elbow should be at a 90 degree angle.
2
Rotate your shoulder by bringing your forearm across your body.

candidates.name: Cable Rope Upright Row
candidates.cardText:
Cable Rope Upright Row
Beginner
1
Use a rope attachment with the cable set to the bottom of the machine.
2
Pull your elbows straight up toward the ceiling until the attachment is just below your chin then extend until your elbows are fully extended.

candidates.name: Cable Rope Front Raise
candidates.cardText:
Cable Rope Front Raise
Novice
1
Face away from the cables. Use a rope attachment.
2
With your elbows extended raise your fists straight up to the ceiling until they are at eye level.

candidates.name: Cable Rope Mid Lateral Raise
candidates.cardText:
Cable Rope Mid Lateral Raise
Beginner
1
Place the cable at the same height as your fist when your arms are at your side and stand with the cable crossing your body.
2
While keeping your elbow mostly extended, lift your arm until it's parallel with the floor.

candidates.name: Cable Rope Single Arm Low Lateral Raise
candidates.cardText:
Cable Rope Single Arm Low Lateral Raise
Beginner
1
Use a rope attachment with the cable set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
2
You should vertically abduct at the shoulder raising your arms straight out to the side.
3
Raise until your arms are parallel with the ground and then back to the starting position.

candidates.name: Cable Bar Front Raise
candidates.cardText:
Cable Bar Front Raise
Novice
1
Face away from the cables.
2
With your elbows extended raise your fists straight up to the ceiling until they are at eye level.

candidates.name: Cable Low Bilateral Lateral Raise
candidates.cardText:
Cable Low Bilateral Lateral Raise
Novice
1
Use a handle attachment with the cable set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
2
You should vertically abduct at the shoulder raising your arms straight out to the side.
3
Raise until your arms are parallel with the ground and then back to the starting position.

candidates.name: Cable Decline Bench Press
candidates.cardText:
Cable Decline Bench Press
Beginner
1
Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cables should be set above height.
2
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
3
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.

candidates.name: Cable Bench Press
candidates.cardText:
Cable Bench Press
Novice
1
Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cables should be set to shoulder height.
2
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
3
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.

candidates.name: Cable Decline Single Arm Bench Press
candidates.cardText:
Cable Decline Single Arm Bench Press
Beginner
1
Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cable should be set above shoulder height.
2
Bring one handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
3
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.
